title: F3B-2 Historical Word Pilot and Activities Evidence Review Dossier
evidence_boundaries: Historical source pointers and source-reference review are not word-level evidence or production approval.
No dictionary entry, page, quotation, attestation, sense or access date has been authenticated in this stage.
Proposed lookup forms and IAST are unreviewed preparation, not established morphology or approved transliteration.
Original editorial definitions remain editorial copy and are not dictionary-grounded lexical meanings.
Pending slots instantiate existing AG69H and AG70E review fields but are not attached production evidence records.
No AG63/D02 rotation, D04 selection or AG70D runtime is activated; no generated output or homepage consumes this dossier.
Missing AG69I/J artifacts are not recreated. The surviving AG69F queue and current v2 contracts are used directly.

pending_evidence_template.reviewer_note: Pending capture slot only. No entry-level lookup or language review has been performed.
capture_requirements: Identify a specific dictionary and edition, not only a collection or portal homepage.
Record author/editor, publisher, exact headword and a stable entry, page/column or scan locator.
Record the entry URL where available; otherwise retain a precise bibliographic locator.
Record the actual access date and evidence language only after examining the entry.
Record the supported sense and its limits separately from Drishvara editorial reflections.
Check citation/reuse restrictions and use bounded evidence notes, never bulk dictionary text.
Attach an evidence ID and reviewer decision only after actual capture; access alone is not approval.

word_qualification_gaps: Exact Sanskrit and Hindi lexical evidence, entry locators and linked source/evidence IDs.
Reviewed script, IAST, lemma/stem versus inflected form and morphology where applicable.
Supported bilingual semantics, semantic range, usage boundary and separately reviewed reflective sense.
Explicit etymology status; no fabricated root, derivation or historical claim.
Source access/reuse, internal textual discipline, linguistic, safety and editorial reviews.
Public-use and approved-bank gates remain unmet; research eligibility is not output eligibility.
Future date/context assignment, reviewed context matching, duplicate/history checks and output connector approval remain separate gates.

activity_publication_conditions: English/Hindi editorial and safety approval of a separately versioned publication candidate.
Present optional editorial suggestions, never universal duties, religious prohibitions, guaranteed auspiciousness or personal prescriptions.
Do not derive recommendations from generic Panchang labels or assert traditional authority without scoped exact evidence.
Do not reactivate the historical weekday-first D04 selector or legacy Word rotation.

Future presentation or selection requires explicit authorization; this dossier is not a public source.

output_fields.guidance_text_en: Use the day for patient work, measured speech, and responsible closure of pending tasks.
output_fields.guidance_text_hi: दिन का उपयोग धैर्यपूर्ण कार्य, मापा हुआ वचन और लंबित कार्यों के जिम्मेदार समापन के लिए करें।
output_fields.recommended_action_en: Review one pending responsibility and close it carefully.
output_fields.recommended_action_hi: एक लंबित जिम्मेदारी की समीक्षा करें और उसे सावधानी से पूरा करें।
output_fields.avoidance_note_en: Avoid hurried decisions and unnecessary confrontation.
output_fields.avoidance_note_hi: जल्दबाजी वाले निर्णय और अनावश्यक टकराव से बचें।
output_fields.source_basis: Editorial placeholder aligned with weekday-reflection model; not dynamic Panchang output.

historical_selection.dependency_note: A weekday match precedes word-theme and fallback matching in the non-live D04 preview builder; it does not establish a traditional Saturday rule.

editorial_review.english_hindi_consistency: Broadly aligned on patient work, measured speech and task closure; Hindi fluency and tone remain pending human review.
safety_notes: Imperative action and avoidance language must not imply a religious prohibition.
Saturday suitability has no attached source evidence.
Do not imply every pending responsibility can safely or realistically be closed today.
editorial_review.rewrite_scope: Separate optional neutral advice from the unsupported Saturday linkage and review prescriptive framing; source copy remains unchanged.

output_fields.guidance_text_en: Pause long enough to separate immediate emotion from considered understanding.

output_fields.recommended_action_en: Write down one thought before acting on it.

output_fields.avoidance_note_en: Avoid reacting only because the moment feels urgent.

historical_selection.dependency_note: D04 reads the D02 reflection theme after no weekday match. Its approved-bank wording describes legacy preview status, not AG70D source/publication approval.

editorial_review.english_hindi_consistency: Both versions advise reflection before action; the Hindi urgency phrase is interpretive rather than literal and needs bilingual editorial review.
safety_notes: A reflective suggestion must not discourage genuinely time-critical action.
No therapeutic, astronomical or traditional authority is established.
Any future theme linkage must use eligible AG70D output, never legacy preview approval.
editorial_review.rewrite_scope: Review optional and non-universal framing and correct legacy approval provenance in a future publication candidate; do not change the source template.

output_fields.recommended_action_hi: एक सार्थक कार्य चुनें और उसे बिना विचलन पूरा करें।
output_fields.avoidance_note_en: Avoid scattering attention across too many concerns.

historical_selection.dependency_note: Chosen after no weekday or word-theme match; no Thursday, balance or awareness-based traditional rule is established by the preview.
